name: RC-B10-0143/2026 – After § 12 – Am 11
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on four years of Russia’s war of aggression against Ukraine and European contributions to a just peace and sustained security for Ukraine
part_text: 12b. Calls for the European Union, international donors and reconstruction financing instruments to ensure that all reconstruction programmes include strong occupational health and safety conditionalities aligned with high-level standards, including comprehensive asbestos risk mapping, specialised worker training, certification of removal professionals, proper disposal systems, and the systematic involvement of trade unions and social partners in the design, implementation and monitoring of reconstruction projects, with a view to guaranteeing safe working conditions and promoting decent, sustainable employment throughout the reconstruction process;
